title: The Cat and the Dragon
overview: A dragon protects the cats in the forest from cruel humans. One day, one of his students befriends a boy.

title: The Mother Cat and the Girl
overview: Mom Cat meets Anne Rossa, the girl who summoned her at the magic school.

title: The Kittens and the Winged Uncle
overview: Dragon continues to raise kittens and teach them hunting and magic, and some kittens are simply one of a kind.

title: The Black Cat and the Prince
overview: A black cat named Kurobane meets a human prince, Stan, who wishes to become an adventurer.

title: The White Cat and the Girl
overview: A white cat named Shirotae befriends an orphan girl named Gallie, who is terrible at hunting.

title: The Evening of Foxtails
overview: Foxtails are rare in the forest, but there once was a cat who created a field of foxtail in the forest.

title: The Return of the Mother Cat
overview: At long last, the Mother Cat is reunited with the Dragon in the forest.

title: Life in the Castle Town & the Black Cat and the Adventurous Prince
overview: Haibuchi explores the city to pass the time. Then, Stan and Kurobane take a class.

title: The White Cat and the Lazy Girl
overview: Shirotae tries to motivate Gallie to learn magic.

title: The Demon and the Dragon and Mother's Day
overview: Dragon and Greater Demon decide to surprise their mother with a gift on Mother's Day.

title: Final Resting Place
overview: Pompora visits his friends and looks back on his life before finding his resting place.
